title: Kilo Code
oneLiner: Open-source AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI with 500+ models, specialized modes, and cloud agent deployment.
summary: Kilo Code is an open-source AI coding agent that works across VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, and Slack with 500+ models via the Kilo Gateway. It features specialized agent modes (Code, Architect, Debug, Ask), cloud-based agent deployment (KiloClaw), AI-powered code review, and a marketplace of MCP servers and modes.
whyItMatters: Kilo Code is backed by $8M in seed funding from GitLab's co-founder and combines the best features of Cline and Roo Code into an all-in-one platform. Its zero-markup pricing on 500+ models and cloud agent deployment make it a unique offering in the open-source coding agent space.
bestFor: Developers who want maximum model choice with zero-markup pricing
Teams that need VS Code, JetBrains, and CLI support from one tool
Engineers who want cloud-hosted agent deployment alongside IDE integration
notFor: Users who prefer lightweight, single-purpose terminal agents
Teams that are satisfied with simpler, more established coding agents

coreStrengths.title: 500+ models at zero markup
coreStrengths.description: Access over 500 models through the Kilo Gateway at exact provider rates with no markup.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Model choice without price inflation means developers can use the best model for each task without paying a premium.

coreStrengths.title: Multi-surface coverage
coreStrengths.description: Works in VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, Slack, and Cloud — with session sync across all surfaces.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Start a task on your phone, refine in the CLI, and finish in your IDE — all from the same agent session.

coreStrengths.title: Specialized agent modes
coreStrengths.description: Code, Architect, Debug, and Ask modes — each with tailored instructions and tool permissions.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Different tasks need different agent behaviors. Mode switching keeps the agent focused and efficient.

coreStrengths.title: Cloud agent deployment
coreStrengths.description: KiloClaw lets you deploy OpenClaw-compatible agents to the cloud with one click — no SSH, Docker, or YAML required.
coreStrengths.whyItMatters: Teams can run 24/7 agents without managing infrastructure, with auto-restart, monitoring, and security updates included.

useCaseNotes.title: Multi-model experimentation
useCaseNotes.description: Switch between 500+ models to find the best performer for your specific codebase and tasks.

useCaseNotes.title: Cross-platform development
useCaseNotes.description: Use Kilo Code in VS Code for frontend work, JetBrains for backend, and CLI for DevOps tasks — all with consistent behavior.

useCaseNotes.title: Automated code review in CI
useCaseNotes.description: Set up AI-powered code reviews that run automatically on pull requests, with configurable rules and model selection.

compareNotes.title: Choose Kilo Code for model breadth and platform coverage
compareNotes.summary: Kilo Code offers 500+ models, JetBrains support, and cloud agent deployment. Cline has a larger community and more mature ecosystem.

commandLine.label: Install Kilo Code CLI
commandLine.description: Install via Homebrew, then run 'kilo' in any project directory. Also available as a VS Code and JetBrains extension.

seoArticle.intro: Kilo Code is the most ambitious all-in-one open-source coding agent platform. With $8M in seed funding from GitLab's co-founder, support for 500+ models, and a vision that spans VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, Slack, and cloud agents, Kilo Code is building the broadest platform in the open-source coding agent space.
seoArticle.whatItIs: Kilo Code is an open-source AI coding agent that works across VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, Slack, and Cloud. It features 500+ models with zero markup, specialized agent modes, AI code review, and one-click cloud agent deployment.
seoArticle.whyItMatters: Kilo Code's all-in-one approach addresses a fragmentation problem in the coding agent space — developers currently need different tools for terminal, IDE, code review, and cloud automation. Kilo Code aims to be the single platform for all of these workflows.
seoArticle.howItWorks: Start with one safe workflow for Kilo Code. Inspect official setup instructions, required credentials, execution logs, approval points, and failure recovery before expanding from a sandbox task into production automation.

useCases.title: Enterprise-scale model selection
useCases.description: Use Kilo Code's model gateway to run different models for different tasks — cheap models for boilerplate, frontier models for complex reasoning.

useCases.title: 24/7 background automation
useCases.description: Deploy KiloClaw agents that monitor repositories, triage issues, and run scheduled tasks while your team is offline.

useCases.title: Team-wide AI adoption
useCases.description: Standardize on Kilo Code across your team to get consistent AI coding capabilities regardless of individual editor preferences.

alternatives.title: Use Cline for a more established ecosystem
alternatives.summary: Kilo Code offers broader platform coverage and more models. Cline has a larger community, more extensions, and longer track record.

alternatives.title: Use OpenCode for simpler multi-provider workflows
alternatives.summary: Kilo Code is more feature-rich across more surfaces. OpenCode offers a simpler, more focused experience with 75+ providers.

faq.answer: Start with one safe workflow for Kilo Code. Inspect official setup instructions, required credentials, execution logs, approval points, and failure recovery before expanding from a sandbox task into production automation.

faq.question: Is Kilo Code open source?
faq.answer: Kilo Code is listed with Apache-2.0 based on the official source links in this profile. The core VS Code extension is open source.

faq.question: What models does Kilo Code support?
faq.answer: Kilo Code supports 500+ models through the Kilo Gateway, including Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, local Ollama models, and more.
